topic: Why outbound automation tools burn accounts
hook:
Most teams think outbound fails because of deliverability.

It usually fails because nobody bothered to read the prospect's profile.
body:
Here is what happens when you switch from 500 automated blasts to 15 peer-level observations per week:

1. Response rate jumps from 1.5% to 24%
2. Zero connection blocks
3. The prospect actually thanks you for reaching out

Quality is the only scalable moat left on LinkedIn.
call_to_action: Are you optimizing for volume or relevance this quarter?
